envelope.description: Give the vector store the owner rule

body.title: Give the vector store the owner rule
body.summary: getLanceConn refuses the live ~/.insrc/lance (resolved through links, relative paths included) with LanceStoreNotOwnerError to a process that has not called declareLiveStoreOwner, before creating or connecting; add isLiveStoreOwnerDeclared to the store module; audit every test file in a temporary home for opens of the live vector store and give each a temporary path. Independent of the move, so it lands early and every later sweep runs with it.
acceptanceChecks: no declaration: the live path is refused and nothing is created
after the declaration it opens; a temporary path opens without one; a relative path and a symbolic link to the live path are refused
the audit finds no test file that leaves ~/.insrc/lance in its temporary home

tests.name: vector store owner rule: live path refused with no declaration and nothing created; opens after declareLiveStoreOwner; a temporary path opens; relative path and symbolic link refused
no test opens the live vector store: each repaired test file run in a temporary home leaves no lance directory
